observations: The six-arena table lists WfCommons, DataSciBench, SWE-bench Verified, Defects4J, SimulCost and Bazel.
The engine receives an explicit graph, goal, materializers, guards and barriers; demand is refreshed after progress.
The DataSciBench adaptation plans once, executes real code, and evaluates separate deliverables with an LLM judge.
Projection and reuse are shared mechanisms requiring matched eager controls.
inference: Interleaved persistent Python with deferred response capabilities is a distinct implementation setting, not evidence of a new principle. The paper already permits graph growth and changing demands. A comparison against ordinary lazy reads and equally capable caching remains necessary.
